selected.title: Starling build agentic fincrime investigator that takes 17 seconds
selected.summary: Starling has deployed an agentic financial crime investigator that the UK digital bank says can carry out an end-to-end investigation within 17 seconds.
selected.why: Major deployment of autonomous AI agents for financial crime investigations in banking.

reason: AI financial crime investigation speed claims need scrutiny: does 17 seconds indicate genuine capability or regulatory theater that may miss complex patterns?
angle: Autonomous agents replacing human financial crime investigators may create speed-theater that mistakes efficiency for effectiveness, potentially missing sophisticated laundering schemes.
